integrity: A standalone exact rational checker accompanies the fully specified analytical proof; numerical/finite graph checks are not substituted for universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite trees, arbitrary edge orientations, real Euclidean isotonic projection, uniform vertex least squares and unweighted graph-total-variation seminorm only. Not graph cycles, weighted objectives, other target metrics, or full classification of all globally norming pairs. Potential prior implicit formulations of the edge-variation norm remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact tree-variation sensitivity of isotonic projection and unbounded cubic-branch amplification
